zh-CN.title: 墨子的兼爱、非攻与工艺论辩
zh-CN.shortSummary: 墨家将社会互助、战争批评与工艺知识放入先秦秩序论辩。
curatorialDescription: 这是思想活动的分析性时段，不把墨家文本压缩成一次可定位的讲学。
zh-CN.researchNote: 墨子活动年代与篇章层次仍需继续核对。

en.title: Mozi's debates on universal care, non-aggression and craft
en.shortSummary: Mohist argument placed social mutuality, criticism of war and technical knowledge within pre-Qin debates on order.
curatorialDescription: This is an analytical period of intellectual activity, not one precisely located teaching session.
en.researchNote: The dates of Mozi's activity and the textual layers remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 韩非的法术势论述
zh-CN.shortSummary: 韩非在战国政治竞争中集中讨论法、术、势与君主治理。
curatorialDescription: 事件表达思想与文本形成语境，不把现存《韩非子》视为单一时点完成的全书。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章归属和韩国政治背景仍需按史传与文本研究细化。

en.title: Han Fei's writings on law, technique and power
en.shortSummary: Han Fei addressed law, technique, power and rulership amid Warring States political competition.
curatorialDescription: The event describes an intellectual and textual setting, not a single completion date for the received Han Feizi.
en.researchNote: Chapter attribution and the Han-state context require further review across biography and text studies.

zh-CN.title: 贾谊与长沙政论
zh-CN.shortSummary: 贾谊的政论和地方任职把汉初礼制、帝国治理与长沙经验连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 长沙作为任职与贬谪的地方尺度，人物文本与后世祠祀记忆分开。
zh-CN.researchNote: 政论篇章和长沙活动的具体时间仍需继续核对。

en.title: Jia Yi's Changsha statecraft
en.shortSummary: Jia Yi's memorials and local office connected early Han ritual, imperial governance and the experience of Changsha.
curatorialDescription: Changsha expresses the scale of office and exile, while later shrine memory remains separate.
en.researchNote: The dates of the memorials and Changsha activity require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 王弼注《老子》与《周易》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 王弼以魏晋玄学重释老庄与易学，形成经典接受史中的关键转折。
curatorialDescription: 注释事件表达后世解释层，不回写为老子时代的原始语境。
zh-CN.researchNote: 注本版本、玄学术语和文本编纂层次仍需继续核查。

en.title: Wang Bi's commentaries on the Daodejing and Zhouyi
en.shortSummary: Wang Bi reread Lao–Zhuang and Yijing learning through Wei–Jin xuanxue, creating a major turn in reception history.
curatorialDescription: The commentary event records a later interpretive layer rather than projecting it back into Laozi's setting.
en.researchNote: Witnesses, xuanxue terminology and textual compilation layers remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 刘勰编写《文心雕龙》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《文心雕龙》把六朝文学批评、经典秩序和佛教文化环境组织成系统文论。
curatorialDescription: 事件表达文本形成与流通语境，不把全书压缩为单次写作。
zh-CN.researchNote: 刘勰生平资料与成书年代仍需继续分层。

en.title: Liu Xie and the formation of Wenxin Diaolong
en.shortSummary: Wenxin Diaolong organised Six Dynasties criticism, classical order and Buddhist cultural context into a systematic poetics.
curatorialDescription: The event describes textual formation and circulation rather than one act of writing.
en.researchNote: Liu Xie's sparse biography and the date of composition remain layered questions.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 480—520 年；成书层次有争议

zh-CN.title: 柳宗元永州写作与地方观察
zh-CN.shortSummary: 贬谪时期的永州写作把地方山水、政治经验与古文传统连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 永州是活动和写作的城市尺度锚点，不声称保留完整逐日行迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文集、墓志和地方空间之间的对应仍需继续核实。

en.title: Liu Zongyuan's Yongzhou writing and local observation
en.shortSummary: Writing during exile in Yongzhou connected local landscapes, political experience and the guwen tradition.
curatorialDescription: Yongzhou is a city-scale anchor for activity and writing, not a claim of a complete day-by-day itinerary.
en.researchNote: The correspondence between collected works, epitaphs and local space requires further review.

zh-CN.title: 张载关中讲学与气论
zh-CN.shortSummary: 张载在关中讲学，以气论重建宋代儒学的宇宙论与伦理秩序。
curatorialDescription: 凤翔作为区域活动锚点；后世名句传播和具体讲堂位置不混为一谈。
zh-CN.researchNote: 讲学地点和文集版本需继续按宋代材料核对。

en.title: Zhang Zai's Guanzhong teaching and qi theory
en.shortSummary: Zhang Zai's Guanzhong teaching used qi theory to rebuild a cosmology and ethical order for Song Confucianism.
curatorialDescription: Fengxiang is a regional activity anchor; later circulation of famous sayings is not a precise teaching location.
en.researchNote: Teaching sites and textual witnesses require further checking across Song sources.

zh-CN.title: 陆九渊象山讲学
zh-CN.shortSummary: 陆九渊以心学和象山讲学拓展南宋儒学的地方传播网络。
curatorialDescription: 金溪是讲学和地方网络锚点，陆朱关系在后续人物关系中保留思想争论层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 讲学活动与《象山语录》形成层次仍需继续核对。

en.title: Lu Jiuyuan's Xiangshan teaching
en.shortSummary: Lu Jiuyuan expanded Southern Song transmission through mind learning and the Xiangshan local network.
curatorialDescription: Jinxi is an anchor for teaching and local networks; the Lu–Zhu relation retains its intellectual debate layer.
en.researchNote: The activity and formation layers of the Xiangshan sayings require further review.

zh-CN.title: 黄宗羲编纂《明儒学案》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 黄宗羲以学术史编纂整理明代儒学人物、师承与地方学派。
curatorialDescription: 这是知识整理与记忆建构事件，不是无争议的现代人物分类。
zh-CN.researchNote: 版本、取舍和东浙网络需继续按清初文献核对。

en.title: Huang Zongxi compiles Mingru xue'an
en.shortSummary: Huang Zongxi organised Ming Confucian figures, lineages and local schools through an intellectual-history compilation.
curatorialDescription: This is an event of knowledge organisation and memory construction, not an uncontested modern classification.
en.researchNote: Editions, selections and the Eastern Zhejiang network remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 顾炎武考据与经世行旅
zh-CN.shortSummary: 顾炎武以地方考察、经世论和金石文献研究重建明清之际知识网络。
curatorialDescription: 事件表达长期行旅与研究活动，不把后世名句归属当作单一史实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 日记、文集和行旅路线仍需继续逐段对齐。

en.title: Gu Yanwu's evidential learning and statecraft travels
en.shortSummary: Gu Yanwu rebuilt a Ming–Qing knowledge network through local investigation, statecraft and the study of inscriptions.
curatorialDescription: This is a long activity period; later attribution of famous phrases is not treated as one historical fact.
en.researchNote: Diaries, collected works and travel routes require further point-by-point alignment.

zh-CN.title: 戴震的音韵训诂与经学考证
zh-CN.shortSummary: 戴震以音韵、训诂和经学考证推进清代知识方法转型。
curatorialDescription: 事件表现学术方法与文本生产，避免把现代‘考据学’当作当时唯一身份。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述版本和与乾嘉学者的交往仍需继续核实。

en.title: Dai Zhen's philology and classical exegesis
en.shortSummary: Dai Zhen advanced Qing intellectual methods through phonology, exegesis and classical research.
curatorialDescription: The event records scholarly method and textual production without treating modern ‘evidential learning’ as his only period identity.
en.researchNote: Textual witnesses and exchanges with Qianlong-era scholars remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 蔡元培与现代大学教育
zh-CN.shortSummary: 蔡元培把传统学术、多元教育理念与现代大学制度连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 北京是现代教育制度活动空间，绍兴保留出生地与早期文化背景；二者通过人物—地点关系联动。
zh-CN.researchNote: 教育改革档案和北大制度史仍需继续补证。

en.title: Cai Yuanpei and modern university education
en.shortSummary: Cai Yuanpei connected classical scholarship, plural education and the modern university institution.
curatorialDescription: Beijing is the modern educational setting while Shaoxing retains birthplace and early cultural context; the two are linked through figure–place relations.
en.researchNote: Education reform archives and Peking University institutional history require further evidence.

zh-CN.title: 司马迁编纂《史记》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《史记》将王朝、人物、地方和传说组织为可持续重读的历史叙事。
curatorialDescription: 长安是编纂制度锚点，韩城是家族与出生地传统；事件不把全书视为一次完成。
zh-CN.researchNote: 成书阶段、史料来源与司马迁个人叙事需继续分层。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约前 2 世纪末—前 1 世纪

en.title: Sima Qian compiles the Shiji
en.shortSummary: The Shiji organised dynasties, people, places and legend into a durable historical narrative.
curatorialDescription: Chang'an is the compilation anchor and Hancheng the family and birthplace tradition; the work is not treated as completed in one moment.
en.researchNote: Stages of completion, sources and Sima Qian's self-narrative require layered review.

zh-CN.title: 班固编纂《汉书》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 班固承接纪传史传统，整理西汉制度、人物与历史记忆。
curatorialDescription: 长安是史学编纂和班氏家族网络的制度锚点；班昭等人的编纂分工需保留。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本完成阶段和编纂分工仍需继续依据传记与版本核对。

en.title: Ban Gu compiles the Hanshu
en.shortSummary: Ban Gu extended biographical history by organising Western Han institutions, figures and historical memory.
curatorialDescription: Chang'an is an institutional anchor for historiography and the Ban family network; the division of labour with Ban Zhao remains visible.
en.researchNote: Completion phases and editorial labour require further checking through biographies and editions.

zh-CN.title: 《参同契》传统的形成
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《参同契》传统把易学、炼丹和后世内丹解释叠加为一组文本记忆。
curatorialDescription: 事件使用传统时间，不把魏伯阳传说或上虞记忆当作已证实历史地点。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本成书层次、作者归属和后世注解仍有争议。

en.title: Formation of the Cantongqi tradition
en.shortSummary: The Cantongqi tradition layers Yijing learning, alchemy and later inner-alchemical interpretation into a textual memory.
curatorialDescription: The event uses traditional time and does not treat Wei Boyang's legend or Shangyu memory as verified historical location.
en.researchNote: Composition layers, attribution and later commentaries remain contested.

displayDate.zh-CN: 《参同契》传统；年代与归属有争议
displayDate.en: Cantongqi tradition; date and attribution contested

zh-CN.title: 净明传统与许逊地方记忆
zh-CN.shortSummary: 净明传统把治水、地方保护神与道教教团记忆叠合在南昌空间。
curatorialDescription: 事件呈现传统与记忆层，不把传说中的治水路线画为历史路线。
zh-CN.researchNote: 净明传统的成形时间和地方文本仍需继续核对。

en.title: Jingming tradition and Xu Xun local memory
en.shortSummary: The Jingming tradition layers water-control legend, local protective deity memory and Daoist community history in Nanchang.
curatorialDescription: The event records tradition and memory; legendary water-control routes are not drawn as historical routes.
en.researchNote: The formation dates and local textual witnesses of Jingming tradition remain under review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 净明传统与地方记忆；无单一年代
displayDate.en: Jingming tradition and local memory; no single date

zh-CN.title: 张伯端《悟真篇》内丹传统
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《悟真篇》把易学语言、内丹修炼和宋代道教文本传播连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 天台山是山地与记忆锚点；内丹术语按思想史和文本史处理。
zh-CN.researchNote: 作者生平、文本版本和天台活动仍需继续考证。

en.title: Zhang Boduan and the Wuzhen pian inner-alchemy tradition
en.shortSummary: The Wuzhen pian tradition connects Yijing language, inner cultivation and Song Daoist textual circulation.
curatorialDescription: Mount Tiantai is a mountain and memory anchor; inner-alchemical language is treated as intellectual and textual history.
en.researchNote: Biography, textual witnesses and Tiantai activity require further review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 11 世纪；《悟真篇》传播层
displayDate.en: around the eleventh century; Wuzhen pian circulation layer

zh-CN.title: 丘处机与全真北方网络
zh-CN.shortSummary: 丘处机将全真修行、燕京城市空间与跨区域政治交往连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 北京是活动锚点；西行会见另作具体事件，不泛化为全真网络的所有关系。
zh-CN.researchNote: 传记路线和龙门谱系仍需继续分层。

en.title: Qiu Chuji and the northern Quanzhen network
en.shortSummary: Qiu Chuji connected Quanzhen practice, Yanjing urban space and transregional political exchange.
curatorialDescription: Beijing is the activity anchor; the westward meeting remains a separate event rather than a general network claim.
en.researchNote: The biographical route and Longmen genealogy remain layered questions.
en.timeLabel: turn of the thirteenth century CE

zh-CN.title: 刘处玄的全真教团活动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 刘处玄在宁海地方网络中参与全真早期教团与修行传播。
curatorialDescription: 宁海表达区域网络，不把同门关系自动解释为直接会面。
zh-CN.researchNote: 传记与地方活动的对应仍需继续核实。

en.title: Liu Chuxuan's Quanzhen community activity
en.shortSummary: Liu Chuxuan participated in early Quanzhen community and practice transmission within a Ninghai local network.
curatorialDescription: Ninghai expresses a regional network and does not turn every colleague relation into a direct meeting.
en.researchNote: The correspondence between biography and local activity requires further review.

zh-CN.title: 马丹阳与全真早期传承
zh-CN.shortSummary: 马丹阳把宁海修行空间、全真教团与王重阳的传承网络连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 事件表达教团传承和活动网络，后世七真谱系另保留接受层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 弟子网络、碑传和活动地点仍需继续对齐。

en.title: Ma Danyang and early Quanzhen transmission
en.shortSummary: Ma Danyang connected Ninghai practice settings, Quanzhen community and Wang Chongyang's transmission network.
curatorialDescription: The event records community transmission and activity; later Seven Perfected genealogy remains a reception layer.
en.researchNote: Disciple networks, inscriptions and activity sites require further alignment.

zh-CN.title: 孙不二的全真女性修行
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孙不二使全真早期女性修行与宁海教团网络进入可见的历史语境。
curatorialDescription: 女性修行与后世神仙化称谓分层处理，不用传奇替代生平证据。
zh-CN.researchNote: 女性全真传承与地方活动仍需继续对读碑传与教内文献。

en.title: Sun Bu'er and female Quanzhen practice
en.shortSummary: Sun Bu'er makes early Quanzhen women's practice and the Ninghai community network visible in historical context.
curatorialDescription: Women's practice and later immortalised titles are kept separate; legend does not replace biography.
en.researchNote: Female Quanzhen transmission and local activity require further comparison across inscriptions and internal writings.

zh-CN.title: 杜光庭的道教仪式与经典编纂
zh-CN.shortSummary: 杜光庭把成都宫观、道教仪式和晚唐五代经典整理连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 事件表达制度与文本生产，不把后世道藏编排全部归于个人。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述真伪、宫观活动与五代政治关系仍需继续核对。

en.title: Du Guangting's Daoist ritual and canon-making
en.shortSummary: Du Guangting connected Chengdu temples, Daoist ritual and textual organisation across the late Tang and Five Dynasties.
curatorialDescription: The event records institutions and textual production without attributing the whole later Daoist canon to one person.
en.researchNote: Attribution, temple activity and Five Dynasties political relations remain under review.
en.timeLabel: turn of the tenth century CE

zh-CN.title: 王常月与清初龙门戒律网络
zh-CN.shortSummary: 王常月与清初北京宫观、授戒和龙门教团复兴相连。
curatorialDescription: 事件保留清初教团组织化与后世谱系之间的距离。
zh-CN.researchNote: 生卒、授戒时间和宫观关系仍需继续核实。

en.title: Wang Changyue and early Qing Longmen ordination networks
en.shortSummary: Wang Changyue is linked with early Qing Beijing temples, ordination and Longmen community revival.
curatorialDescription: The event retains the distance between early Qing organisation and later genealogy.
en.researchNote: Life dates, ordination chronology and temple relations remain under review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 17 世纪；授戒年代待核
displayDate.en: around the seventeenth century; ordination dates under review

zh-CN.title: 刘一明的清代内丹著述
zh-CN.shortSummary: 刘一明以丹道和易学著述连接清代修炼文本与地方知识网络。
curatorialDescription: 事件将丹道术语作为思想和文本史处理，不作医学事实断言。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著作版本、活动地点和龙门关联仍需继续核对。

en.title: Liu Yiming's Qing inner-alchemy writings
en.shortSummary: Liu Yiming connected Qing cultivation texts and local knowledge networks through inner-alchemy and Yijing writing.
curatorialDescription: Alchemical terminology is treated as intellectual and textual history, not medical fact.
en.researchNote: Textual witnesses, activity sites and Longmen associations remain under review.
en.timeLabel: turn of the nineteenth century CE

zh-CN.title: 安世高洛阳译经活动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 安世高的早期译经把禅修文本和西域佛教知识带入洛阳传播网络。
curatorialDescription: 译经活动的城市锚点不等于所有译本都由同一译场一次完成。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍归属与活动年代需继续对读目录和传记。

en.title: An Shigao's Luoyang translation activity
en.shortSummary: An Shigao's early translations brought meditation texts and western Buddhist knowledge into the Luoyang network.
curatorialDescription: The city anchor does not mean every attributed translation was completed in one workshop or moment.
en.researchNote: Attribution and activity dates require further comparison across catalogues and biographies.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约东汉中期；译经年代有争议
displayDate.en: around the middle Eastern Han; translation dates contested

zh-CN.title: 支谦吴地译经活动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 支谦参与的汉译佛典把吴地城市、译师流动与早期佛教语言转化连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 建康是区域译经锚点，目录归属和译本合作保持证据层次。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍数量、活动地点和译名仍需继续核对。

en.title: Zhi Qian's Wu-region translation activity
en.shortSummary: Zhi Qian's Chinese Buddhist translations connected Wu cities, translator mobility and early Buddhist language.
curatorialDescription: Jiankang is a regional translation anchor; catalogue attribution and collaboration retain their evidence layers.
en.researchNote: The corpus, activity sites and translated names require further review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 3 世纪；译经活动待分层
displayDate.en: around the third century; activity requires layered dating

zh-CN.title: 昙无谶姑臧译经
zh-CN.shortSummary: 昙无谶在北凉语境中翻译大乘经典，把河西走廊与北方佛教文本网络连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 姑臧是北凉译场锚点，译经工程和后世教义影响分开。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍、译场合作和传记叙事仍需继续核对。

en.title: Dharmaksema's Guzang translations
en.shortSummary: Dharmaksema translated Mahayana scriptures in the Northern Liang setting, connecting the Hexi Corridor with northern Buddhist texts.
curatorialDescription: Guzang is the Northern Liang workshop anchor; translation projects and later doctrinal influence remain separate.
en.researchNote: The corpus, workshop collaboration and biographical narrative require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 佛陀跋陀罗建康译经
zh-CN.shortSummary: 佛陀跋陀罗在建康译出禅修与大乘相关文本，参与东晋佛教制度网络。
curatorialDescription: 建康作为译经制度入口；与慧远、法显的关系按传记和译场证据分层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍、译场和活动地点仍需继续核对。

en.title: Buddhabhadra's Jiankang translations
en.shortSummary: Buddhabhadra translated meditation and Mahayana-related texts in Jiankang within an Eastern Jin Buddhist institutional network.
curatorialDescription: Jiankang is the translation-institution entry; relations with Huiyuan and Faxian remain layered by biography and workshop evidence.
en.researchNote: The corpus, workshop and activity sites require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 求那跋摩建康译经与戒律传播
zh-CN.shortSummary: 求那跋摩在刘宋建康传播戒律与佛教文本，连接海上流动和宫廷制度。
curatorialDescription: 建康为译经与戒律空间，跨海来华路线保持区域网络尺度。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍、来华路线和宫廷关系仍需继续核对。

en.title: Gunavarman's Jiankang translation and vinaya transmission
en.shortSummary: Gunavarman transmitted vinaya and Buddhist texts in Liu Song Jiankang, connecting maritime mobility with court institutions.
curatorialDescription: Jiankang is the translation and vinaya setting; the maritime route remains regional rather than a precise itinerary.
en.researchNote: The corpus, arrival route and court relations require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 真谛梁陈译经网络
zh-CN.shortSummary: 真谛在南朝语境中参与唯识相关译经，把建康、广州与摄论学传统连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 建康与广州是不同尺度的制度和交通锚点，不能简化为一条确定路线。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译场迁移、译籍归属和摄论宗接受史仍需继续分层。

en.title: Paramartha's Liang–Chen translation network
en.shortSummary: Paramartha worked in a Southern Dynasties setting on Yogacara-related translations linking Jiankang, Guangzhou and the Shelun tradition.
curatorialDescription: Jiankang and Guangzhou are distinct institutional and travel anchors, not one certain route.
en.researchNote: Workshop movements, corpus attribution and Shelun reception remain layered questions.

zh-CN.title: 菩提流支洛阳译经
zh-CN.shortSummary: 菩提流支在北魏洛阳参与大乘论书译传，形成北方译经网络的重要一环。
curatorialDescription: 洛阳作为译场和寺院制度锚点，译师之间关系保留合作与竞争的证据层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍和译场争议仍需继续核实。

en.title: Bodhiruci's Luoyang translations
en.shortSummary: Bodhiruci participated in the Northern Wei translation of Mahayana treatises in Luoyang, a key link in the northern network.
curatorialDescription: Luoyang is the workshop and monastery anchor; cooperation and competition retain their evidence layers.
en.researchNote: The corpus and workshop debates remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 善无畏长安密教译经
zh-CN.shortSummary: 善无畏在长安参与密教译经与仪式传播，连接印度传统和唐代制度空间。
curatorialDescription: 译经、仪式和后世法脉分别记录，不将后世宗派结构回写到唐代。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译经合作和宫廷活动仍需继续对读目录与传记。

en.title: Shubhakarasimha's Chang'an Esoteric translations
en.shortSummary: Shubhakarasimha worked in Chang'an on Esoteric translation and ritual transmission, connecting Indian traditions with Tang institutions.
curatorialDescription: Translation, ritual and later lineage remain separate rather than projecting later schools into the Tang period.
en.researchNote: Translation collaboration and court activity require further comparison across catalogues and biographies.

zh-CN.title: 金刚智长安密教传译
zh-CN.shortSummary: 金刚智把南亚密教、海上交通和长安译经制度连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 长安为制度锚点，南方交通保留区域网络尺度。
zh-CN.researchNote: 行程、译籍合作和与不空的关系仍需继续核对。

en.title: Vajrabodhi's Chang'an Esoteric transmission
en.shortSummary: Vajrabodhi connected South Asian Esoteric Buddhism, maritime mobility and Chang'an translation institutions.
curatorialDescription: Chang'an is the institutional anchor while southern mobility remains regional.
en.researchNote: Movements, translation collaboration and the relation to Amoghavajra require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 不空的长安密教译经与国家仪式
zh-CN.shortSummary: 不空将密教译经、长安国家仪式与唐代僧侣网络连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 译经、宫廷活动和后世法脉分别建模，以保持人物关系可核查。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译籍目录、宫廷活动和碑传仍需继续对读。

en.title: Amoghavajra's Chang'an Esoteric translations and state ritual
en.shortSummary: Amoghavajra connected Esoteric translation, state ritual and Tang monastic networks in Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: Translation, court activity and later lineage are modelled separately so figure relations remain auditable.
en.researchNote: Catalogues, court records and inscriptions require further comparison.

zh-CN.title: 慧思南岳止观传统
zh-CN.shortSummary: 慧思在南岳的修行与讲学成为天台传统早期形成的重要记忆。
curatorialDescription: 南岳是山地活动和后世宗派记忆锚点；传记与谱系关系分层表达。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述归属和南岳活动仍需继续核对。

en.title: Hui-si's Nanyue meditation tradition
en.shortSummary: Hui-si's practice and teaching at Nanyue became an important memory in the early formation of Tiantai.
curatorialDescription: Nanyue is a mountain activity and later sectarian-memory anchor; biography and genealogy remain layered.
en.researchNote: Textual attribution and Nanyue activity require further review.

zh-CN.title: 湛然重释天台教观
zh-CN.shortSummary: 湛然在中唐重新阐释天台教观，推动山地僧团与宗派记忆复兴。
curatorialDescription: ‘复兴’是解释性概念，事件仍以讲学、著述和僧团网络为具体入口。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述、谱系与制度环境仍需继续核对。

en.title: Zhanran's Tiantai reinterpretation
en.shortSummary: Zhanran reinterpreted Tiantai doctrine and practice in the Middle Tang, strengthening mountain communities and sectarian memory.
curatorialDescription: ‘Revival’ is an interpretive term; teaching, writing and community networks remain the concrete entries.
en.researchNote: Works, genealogy and institutional context require further review.

zh-CN.title: 神会洛阳南宗禅论争
zh-CN.shortSummary: 神会在洛阳语境中塑造南宗禅谱系，并重述慧能的后世地位。
curatorialDescription: 论争、谱系和慧能记忆分层，避免把后世组织直接回写为早期历史。
zh-CN.researchNote: 敦煌文献、语录和论争年代仍需继续核实。

en.title: Shenhui's Luoyang Southern Chan debates
en.shortSummary: In a Luoyang setting, Shenhui shaped the Southern Chan genealogy and reframed Huineng's later standing.
curatorialDescription: Debate, genealogy and Huineng memory remain layered rather than projecting later organisation into the early period.
en.researchNote: Dunhuang witnesses, sayings and debate dates require further checking.

zh-CN.title: 马祖洪州禅网络
zh-CN.shortSummary: 马祖道一把洪州地区的禅修、丛林组织和门下网络连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 南昌作为洪州区域入口；语录编纂与个人现场言说保持区分。
zh-CN.researchNote: 行迹、门人和灯录形成层次仍需继续核对。

en.title: Mazu's Hongzhou Chan network
en.shortSummary: Mazu Daoyi connected meditation, monastic organisation and disciple networks in the Hongzhou region.
curatorialDescription: Nanchang is the Hongzhou regional entry; saying collections remain distinct from an individual's verified setting.
en.researchNote: Movements, disciples and lamp-record layers require further review.

zh-CN.title: 宗密的禅教会通
zh-CN.shortSummary: 宗密把华严教理、禅宗实践与唐代教判写作组织为内部佛教对话。
curatorialDescription: 长安作为知识网络锚点；综合不等于抹平不同传统的历史差异。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述层、荷泽宗关系和敦煌材料仍需继续核对。

en.title: Zongmi's Chan–Huayan synthesis
en.shortSummary: Zongmi organised Huayan doctrine, Chan practice and Tang classificatory writing into an internal Buddhist dialogue.
curatorialDescription: Chang'an is the knowledge-network anchor; synthesis does not erase historical differences between traditions.
en.researchNote: Textual layers, Heze relations and Dunhuang evidence remain under review.

zh-CN.title: 永明延寿的禅净会通
zh-CN.shortSummary: 永明延寿在吴越杭州语境中连接禅宗、净土与寺院制度。
curatorialDescription: ‘禅净双修’作为后世概括与具体著述、寺院网络分层处理。
zh-CN.researchNote: 著述归属和杭州寺院活动仍需继续核对。

en.title: Yongming Yanshou's Chan–Pure Land synthesis
en.shortSummary: Yongming Yanshou connected Chan, Pure Land and temple institutions in the Wuyue–Hangzhou setting.
curatorialDescription: The later summary of ‘dual cultivation’ remains distinct from specific writings and temple networks.
en.researchNote: Textual attribution and Hangzhou activity require further checking.
